result.question: What does the captain say to Elisha?

readings.answer: Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?
readings.support: Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?

assessments.reason: Direct quote from v.19 expressing the same skepticism: even if the LORD made windows in heaven, could it happen—matching “Impossible even if Yahweh opened sky.”

result.reason: The passage explicitly quotes the captain’s skeptical statement, which matches the key’s meaning.
